current.source: The Native terminal surface projects at most the latest 50 normalized history lines into the Composer scope.

proved: Web and Native use one terminal-context normalization, label, block, and append implementation
Native terminal history can create a scoped Composer context chip
the measured Terminal-panel entry control creates a chip from owned connector history and the measured remove control clears it
terminal context alone makes the Composer sendable
measured removal clears the chip and returns the empty Composer to disabled
attachment removal, route-scoped draft restoration, and owned cold restart still pass in the same exact-bundle gate
the running client loaded the recorded bundle through main transport with an advancing server sequence
notYetProved: terminal context persistence across process restart
canonical provider receipt containing terminal context from a real send
matched Web and Lynx terminal-context pixels

classification: Terminal context now has a shared projection and a real Native add, sendable, and remove lifecycle. This is an independently verified PF2 slice; it does not complete PF2 while picker, canonical send receipt, reconnect, file context, and real-input gates remain open.
